Anyone have any tips going into the game? My first time playing something like this so any help is accepted.

Be prepared to switch up tactics. Different enemies require MAJOR changes in tactics. For example, Goblins have TONS of missile blocks. War Monkeys and Dogs cannot be let at your back, Geomancers needs tons of movement and purge etc.

If you're struggling on a mission or against an enemy really pay attention to the kind of attacks they're throwing and the kind of defenses they have. Some enemies you should attack at a distance, some you should just blitzkrieg, some are weak to fire etc.

I usually have a "general strategy" that works for 75% of the missions but as soon as I die I take the time before clicking Replay to retool every one of my guys to maximize my strategy against that particular enemy/dungeon.
